description: List gate activity. Returns recent audit rows for one gate (create, update, enable, disable, delete) ordered newest first. Use the `limit` query parameter to cap the result (1–100, default 20).

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1–100). Defaults to 20.

name: release_flags_activity
